lessons.title: Time Speed Distance Basics
lessons.concept: Distance = Speed × Time. Speed = Distance/Time. Time = Distance/Speed. km/h to m/s: multiply by 5/18.
lessons.worked_example: 90 km/h = 90 × 5/18 = 25 m/s. Train crosses bridge in 36 s → length+speed = 25×36 = 900 m.

lessons.title: Relative Speed
lessons.concept: Same direction: relative speed = difference. Opposite direction: relative speed = sum. Trains crossing: distance = sum of lengths.
lessons.formula: Same dir: |v1−v2|; Opposite dir: v1+v2; Train+bridge: L_train + L_bridge
lessons.worked_example: Train A 90 km/h (25 m/s) crosses bridge in 36 s → L+bridge = 900 m. Train B 100 m shorter, 45 km/h (12.5 m/s) → t = 800/12.5 = 64 s.
mistakes: Adding instead of subtracting for same direction
Forgetting train length in crossing problems

practice.question: Train 90 km/h crosses bridge in 36 s. Train 100 m shorter at 45 km/h time?

questions.question: Train with 90 km/h crosses bridge in 36 seconds. Another train 100 m shorter crosses same bridge at 45 km/h. Time?
A car travels 60 km at 40 km/h and 60 km at 60 km/h. Average speed?
questions.explanation: Total distance = 120. Total time = 60/40 + 60/60 = 1.5 + 1 = 2.5 h. Avg = 120/2.5 = 48 km/h.
